title: Paper-2 previously-deferred experiments (SI 'Planned confirmatory') — completed
server: <compute-host> (48-core, RTX 3080 Ti; BAAIWorm/flygym/flybody fresh builds; engine deterministic)
method_note: Behavioural Hessian computed as Gauss-Newton J^T W J from the observable Jacobian (2*d deterministic rollouts), since the NEURON/MuJoCo engines are non-differentiable and full FD Lanczos over the connectome is infeasible at 150 s/rollout.

full_scale_hessian_flygym.verdict: STRONG: 48-d FlyGym walking controller behavioural Hessian has effective dimension 3 (90%) / 6 (99%) of 48, span 20 orders -> low-dim stiff subspace at higher dim. Answers C10 (fly).

b1_per_channel_baaiworm.verdict: STRONG: 20 named mechanisms, eff-dim 2(90%)/3(99%). STIFF = passive-leak, gap-junction, synaptic, motor-output + a few K channels (EGL-36); SLOPPY = fast Ca (EGL-19, UNC-2) and Ca-activated K (SLO-1/2). Confirms+refines the paper's 'wiring stiff, fast conductances sloppy' thesis with named C. elegans channels; matches Marder compensated-current picture.

connectome_manifold_probe_baaiworm.verdict: REFINEMENT: across the full 3076-d connectome (syn+gj weights), random directions perturb behaviour as much as matched-norm coherent ones (coh/rand 0.57 at sigma=.08, 0.84 at .25) and essentially NO direction is flat (flat-frac ~0). The connectome WEIGHTS are collectively STIFF -> the behavioural-equivalence manifold's sloppy directions live in the biophysical channel parameters (see B1: EGL-19/UNC-2/SLO), NOT in synaptic/gap-junction weights. Consistent with B1 (gj+syn stiff) and Marder.

comparison.note: sim records membrane voltage Vm (136 neurons, behaving); Kato records Ca fluorescence (~100 neurons, immobilized) -> modality+condition mismatch, comparison is qualitative. Some sim cells show numerical voltage outliers (min ~ -3600 mV); corr/PCA on z-scored traces but treat as caveat.

b2_behaviour_to_neural.verdict: MODERATE/qualitative: PGOB-recovered params yield low-dimensional internal neural dynamics (PCA participation ~4.7-4.8 of 136 neurons) with mean |pairwise corr| 0.37-0.39, same regime as Kato real Ca (0.21); PGOB-real ~ default (no strong PGOB advantage). Caveats: Vm-vs-Ca modality, behaving-vs-immobilized, voltage outliers.

b3_mutant_localisation.verdict: Supports NON-IDENTIFIABILITY thesis: knockdowns of the sloppy Ca channels (EGL-19 sig=0.07, UNC-2 0.12, SLO 0.09-0.16) are nearly behaviourally silent -> not localisable from behaviour; detectable mechanisms (synaptic, passive, motor) are mutually confusable (cosine>0.9). Behaviour-only does NOT cleanly pinpoint the perturbed mechanism -> mechanism-level degeneracy, the practical face of the manifold.

e3_mutant_phenotype.verdict: NULL on available data: stiff(gj+syn)-vs-sloppy(ion) knockout behavioural effect MW p=0.70; conservation Spearman rho=0.33 p=0.42. Yemini's 6 coarse OWMD features are too low-resolution (683-feat Tierpsy mutant data not in hand); consistent with SI's stated data-access limit. Keep as limitation.
